modal.title: Best Delegate ×2 — Masters' Summit MUN
modal.desc: Back-to-back Best Delegate at Masters' Summit MUN — first in UNCSW representing Brazil (June 2024), then again in August 2025. Two different agendas, the same method: deep committee research, evidence-first argumentation and coalition-building that holds up over long sessions. Came with a ₹15,000 cash prize.

modal.title: Special Mention — MU20 Opportunity Summit 2024
modal.desc: Special Mention — the third-highest delegate award — in the AIPPM committee at the MU20 Opportunity Summit 2024 (19–21 October, Indore), billed as Asia's biggest high-school career conference. Contemporary Indian policy and economics, high-pressure committee dynamics, and arguments that had to survive scrutiny. Two months earlier: High Commendation — the second-highest award — representing Sweden in ECOSOC at the Sahodaya Model United Nations 2024. The MUN run began at the Delhi Public School Rau Model United Nations 2024 (5–7 April), representing Iceland in UNHCR.

modal.title: Rapid Chess — Strategy Under the Clock
modal.desc: 2nd place in the Under-19 category at the International Chess Day Trophy Rapid Chess Tournament 2025 (Unite Indore Chess Club with Shri Vaishnav Sports Academy, 20 July 2025), scoring 5 points from 6 rounds. Seven months earlier: 10th in Under-18 Boys (13th overall) at the UICC Trophy one-day rapid tournament at Delhi Public School Nipaniya, Indore (8 December 2024), approved by the MP Chess Ad-hoc Committee. Chess is where the analytical habit was built — probabilistic thinking, pattern recognition and calm decisions under time pressure.

modal.title: Transportation Research Project
modal.desc: Conducted an independent research project on Transportation for the Sahodaya Senior Balvigyan (Commerce) inter-school competition (Indore Sahodaya Schools Complex, held at Advanced Academy, Indore, on 6 January 2024) — primary and secondary data collection, identifying patterns in transportation economics and urban mobility, structuring findings into a coherent analytical narrative, and presenting conclusions to a judging panel. Awarded the Best Performance certificate.

modal.title: Debate, Elocution & Quiz
modal.desc: First place across the school's spoken-word circuit — English Debate, English Elocution and Young TV Reporter. Three different formats, one core skill: structure an argument fast, hold a room, and land the point before the clock runs out.

modal.title: Spandan 2024 — 2nd Position
modal.desc: Second position in Spandan 2024's combined QA / GK / Debate category (Toprankers Indore, August 2024), with a ₹3,100 cash prize — a three-discipline gauntlet that tests breadth of general knowledge, buzzer-speed recall and structured argumentation under pressure, all in one sitting.

modal.title: Discipline in Uniform — NCC & Track
modal.desc: Cadet with 9 MP Battalion NCC, Indore. Completed the Combined Annual Training Camp (CATC-II) at LNCT Indore from 16 to 23 August 2022, then passed the NCC Certificate 'A' examination with an A grade — issued 10 August 2023 under the authority of the Ministry of Defence. On the track: 2nd position in the 4×100 m relay at St. Arnold's School (2023–24).
